name: Focus Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Focus Technology Co., Ltd., established in 1996 and based in Nanjing, China, manages an array of e-commerce platforms serving both the domestic Chinese market and international clients. Among its key offerings is Made-in-China.com, a prominent digital marketplace that serves as an extensive online directory connecting global purchasers with a diverse range of products from Chinese manufacturers and suppliers. The company also runs inQbrands.com, a comprehensive service provider that assists businesses with various aspects including product sourcing, cross-border trade solutions, warehousing and logistical support, product innovation and design, brand building and marketing, and the implementation of sales strategies. Furthermore, Focus Technology operates Doba, a platform specializing in dropshipping services; Crov.com, which functions as an integrated wholesale hub; ttnet.net, a B2B portal delivering industry news and media content to suppliers; xyz.cn, an online marketplace for insurance products; and Abiz.com, a system for streamlined procurement management.
